source.author: verg
source.text: O digno coniuncta viro, dum despicis omnes, dumque tibi est odio mea fistula, dumque capellae, hirsutumque supercilium promissaque barba, nec curare deum credis mortalia quemquam!
source.text_original: O digno coniuncta viro, dum despicis omnes, / dumque tibi est odio mea fistula, dumque capellae, / hirsutumque supercilium promissaque barba, / nec curare deum credis mortalia quemquam!
source.text_english: O woman united to a worthy man, while you despise everyone, and while my pipe is hateful to you, and the goats too, and my shaggy eyebrow and promised beard, and while you believe that no god cares for mortal things!

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Alioqui si eaedem carnes erunt, et corpora quae fuerunt, rursum mares et feminae, rursum nuptiae; viris hirsutum supercilium, barba prolixa; mulieribus laeves genae, et angusta pectora, ad concipiendos et pariendos fetus venter et femora dilatanda sunt.
reuse.text_original: Alioqui si eaedem carnes erunt, et corpora quae fuerunt, rursum mares et feminae, rursum nuptiae; viris hirsutum supercilium, barba prolixa; mulieribus laeves genae, et angusta pectora, ad concipiendos et pariendos fetus venter et femora dilatanda sunt.
reuse.text_english: Otherwise, if the same flesh and the same bodies are to exist as before, then there will again be males and females, again marriages; men will have hairy eyebrows and long beards; women smooth cheeks and narrow chests; and for conceiving and bearing children the belly and thighs must be widened.
